label: AB4C_hP72_184_d_4d_d-001
title: AlPO$_{4}$-5 (Framework type AFI) Structure
comments:
This is one of the \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{large-pore AlPO$_{4}$ structures}. It is stable up to 34.4GPa (Lv, 2012). 
 The aluminum and phosphorous atoms can be disordered, leading to what we call the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB2_hP72_192_m_j2kl-001}{(Al,P)O$_{4}$-5 structure}. 
 The AlPO$_{4}$-5 matrix can contain a wide variety of molecules, leading to structures such as \href{current_web_home_dir/A6B18CD24E6_hP110_184_d_3d_a_4d_d-001}{(AlPO$_{4}$)$_{6}$$\cdot$NC$_{9}$}. 
 Space group $P6cc$ \#186 is polar, allowing an arbitary origin of the $z$-axis.  Here we set $z_{1} = 0$ for the Al (12d) site.
